definitions.gloss: epidermis; the outermost layer of skin
definitions.explanation: the thin outer layer of skin that protects the body

examples.japanese: {表皮|ひょうひ}が{傷|きず}ついた。
{表皮|ひょうひ}の{細胞|さいぼう}は{常|つね}に{新|あたら}しくなる。
examples.english: The cells of the epidermis are constantly renewing.

examples.japanese: この{化粧品|けしょうひん}は{表皮|ひょうひ}を{保護|ほご}する。
examples.english: This cosmetic product protects the epidermis.

notes:
SKIN LAYERS:
- {表皮|ひょうひ} - epidermis (outermost layer)
- {真皮|しんぴ} - dermis (middle layer)
- {皮下|ひか}{組織|そしき} - subcutaneous tissue (innermost layer)

MEDICAL/SCIENTIFIC CONTEXT:
{表皮|ひょうひ} is the technical term used in medical and scientific contexts. In everyday speech, {肌|はだ} (skin) is more commonly used.

RELATED WORDS:
- {皮膚|ひふ} - skin (general medical term)
- {肌|はだ} - skin (everyday word, often refers to complexion)
